# Inventory: Inventory Lots and Summary for a Single Asset

Area overview and notes: [inventory.md](../inventory.md)

`GET /inventory` · tenant-scoped token

Get a summary and list of undisposed lots for the given asset for a specific account. Either asset_id or asset_code must be provided. Lots are returned sorted according to the order in which the system disposes them (by highest cost for HIFO, earliest acquisition date for FIFO, latest acquisition date for LIFO, or lowest cost for LOFO).

**Query parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `account_id` | string | No | Your system's unique identifier for the Account. |
| `asset_code` | string | No | The code/symbol of the asset (for example, 'BTC' for Bitcoin). Either asset_id or asset_code must be provided. |
| `asset_id` | string (uuid) | No | The Taxbit UUID of the asset. Either asset_id or asset_code must be provided. |
| `include_summary` | boolean | No | If true, the summary for the asset is included in the response. Default is true. |
| `limit` | integer | No | Number of results to return. Default is 25. |
| `lots_ordered_by` | string | No | The method used to order the items in the lots collection. If not provided, the system orders by the method for that account (either the Account or Payer default). One of: `HIFO`, `FIFO`, `LIFO`, `LOFO`. |
| `offset` | integer | No | Offset for paging through results. Default is 0. |
| `price` | number | No | The current price of the asset. If provided, unrealized gains data is returned. |

**Headers**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `x-user-id` | string (uuid) | No | The Taxbit UUID of the account. Ignored if account_id is specified. |

**Response 200**: Summary of a user's inventory. Lots are sorted by the order in which the system disposes them (or according to the lots_ordered_by query parameter).

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data` | object | No | The unrealized lots the account owns. Summary data is provided if include_summary is set to true. |
| `data.asset` | object | No | The asset referenced by all `quantity` fields. |
| `data.asset.code` | string | Yes | Asset Code (BTC, ETH, LTC, etc.) |
| `data.asset.name` | string | Yes | Asset Full Name. |
| `data.asset.symbol` | string | No | Asset Symbol (Like $). |
| `data.asset.type` | string | Yes | Asset Type. One of: `Fiat`, `Crypto`, `Precious Metal`. |
| `data.asset.uuid` | string (uuid) | Yes | Asset UUID in the Taxbit system. |
| `data.fiat_asset` | object | No | The asset referenced by all `cost` fields. Not present if all lots are missing cost basis. |
| `data.fiat_asset.code` | string | Yes | Asset Code (BTC, ETH, LTC, etc.) |
| `data.fiat_asset.name` | string | Yes | Asset Full Name. |
| `data.fiat_asset.symbol` | string | No | Asset Symbol (Like $). |
| `data.fiat_asset.type` | string | Yes | Asset Type. One of: `Fiat`, `Crypto`, `Precious Metal`. |
| `data.fiat_asset.uuid` | string (uuid) | Yes | Asset UUID in the Taxbit system. |
| `data.summary` | object | No | Overview of the asset owned by the account. Includes unrealized gains data if price is provided. Not present if include_summary was set to false. |
| `data.summary.total_quantity` | string (decimal) | Yes | Total amount of the asset owned. |
| `data.summary.total_quantity_with_cost_basis` | string (decimal) | Yes | Total amount of the asset owned that has known cost basis. |
| `data.summary.total_cost` | string (decimal) | Yes | Sum of all cost bases of the asset's lots in the fiat asset. '0' if all lots are missing cost basis. |
| `data.summary.average_unit_cost` | string (decimal) | Yes | Average cost of each unit of the asset. |
| `data.summary.total_quantity_missing_cost_basis` | string (decimal) | No | The total amount of assets for which the cost basis is missing. |
| `data.summary.went_negative` | boolean | No | Indicates that one or more of the dispositions of the specified asset caused the user's inventory to go negative. This typically implies either the disposition quantity was wrong, or a previous acquisition was never sent to Taxbit. This field is omitted if not true. One of: `true`. |
| `data.summary.client_modified_by_transaction_id` | string | No | The latest customer transaction ID for the asset. |
| `data.summary.latest_transaction_datetime` | string (date-time) | No | The datetime of the latest transaction for the asset. |
| `data.summary.total_current_value` | string (decimal) | No | If the `price` query param is provided, the current value of the owned asset, including lots missing cost basis. |
| `data.summary.total_unrealized_gain_loss` | string (decimal) | No | If the `price` query param is provided, the gain or loss that would be realized by selling all lots of the asset. |
| `data.summary.percent_unrealized_gain_loss` | string (decimal) | No | If the `price` query param is provided, the percent profit (or loss) that would be realized by selling all lots of the asset. |
| `data.summary.locked_quantities` | object | No | Contains quantities of inventory locked by different mechanisms (for example, "stake"). |
| `data.summary.locked_quantities.stake` | string (decimal) | No | Quantity of inventory locked in staking. |
| `data.lots` | array of object | No | Array of lots owned by the account, sorted by the order in which the system disposes them (or according to the lots_ordered_by query parameter). Supports paging. |
| `data.lots[].id` | string (uuid) | Yes | Taxbit UUID for the lot. |
| `data.lots[].acquisition_datetime` | string (date-time) | Yes | ISO-8601 timestamp representing when the lot was acquired. |
| `data.lots[].term` | string | Yes | Describes how long the lot has been held. Short term lots have been held for less than a year, long term lots have been held for a year or longer. One of: `short-term`, `long-term`. |
| `data.lots[].quantity` | string (decimal) | Yes | Amount of the asset left in the lot. |
| `data.lots[].fiat_asset_code` | string | No | Code of the fiat asset referenced by any `cost` field. |
| `data.lots[].cost` | string (decimal) | No | Cost basis of the lot. Not present if the lot is missing cost basis. |
| `data.lots[].unit_cost` | string (decimal) | No | Cost per unit of the asset in the lot. Not present if the lot is missing cost basis. |
| `data.lots[].current_value` | string (decimal) | No | If the `price` param is provided, the value of the lot if sold at that price. |
| `data.lots[].unrealized_gain_loss` | string (decimal) | No | If the `price` param is provided, the gain or loss that would be realized if the lot was sold at that price. |
| `data.lots[].percent_unrealized_gain_loss` | string (decimal) | No | If the `price` param is provided, the percent profit or loss that would be realized if the lot was sold at that price. |
| `data.lots[].missing_cost_basis` | boolean | No | Indicates that there is no cost basis provided for the specified lot. By default, lots created from transfers are missing cost basis. One of: `true`. |
| `data.lots[].client_acquisition_transaction_id` | string | No | The customer transaction ID that added the original lot to inventory. |
| `data.lots[].client_modified_by_transaction_id` | string | No | The customer transaction ID that last disposed a portion of the lot. If the lot quantity remains the original amount it equals the client_acquisition_transaction_id. |
| `data.lots[].lock` | object | No | Included if the lot is locked by a mechanism such as staking and unavailable for disposal. |
| `data.lots[].lock.type` | string | Yes | The type of lock applied to this lot. One of: `stake`. |
| `data.lots[].lock.datetime` | string (date-time) | Yes | The datetime of the transaction that applied the lock. |
| `data.lots[].lock.transaction_id` | string | Yes | The ID of the transaction that applied the lock. |
| `data.lots_ordered_by` | string | No | The method used to order the items in the lots collection. One of: `HIFO`, `FIFO`, `LIFO`, `LOFO`. |
| `calculation_status` | string | No | Indicates the status of data calculations. Can be 'in_progress' when data may be incomplete due to ongoing calculations, or 'complete' when calculations have finished. One of: `in_progress`, `complete`. |

**Errors:** 400 Bad Request · 401 Unauthorized · 429 Too Many Requests
